requirements.name: A notification moves through a fixed lifecycle as the user acts on it

scenarios.name: A full lifecycle walk moves the notification through each status in turn

tests.test: creates, submits, amends, cancels, copies and soft-deletes a notification; fulfilment view reflects each transition; copy no longer dedupes
tests.notes: API statuses Draft → Submitted → Amend → Submitted → Deleted; fulfilment view mirrors each step. Does not assert the user-facing Amending label (covered under 006/008).

scenarios.name: Deleting an already-deleted notification is idempotent

tests.test: creates, submits, amends, cancels, copies and soft-deletes a notification; fulfilment view reflects each transition; copy no longer dedupes
tests.notes: soft-deletes twice; both return Deleted with no error

requirements.name: Copying a notification always produces a new, independent draft, carrying the source's answers

scenarios.name: Copying a notification twice produces two distinct drafts

tests.test: creates, submits, amends, cancels, copies and soft-deletes a notification; fulfilment view reflects each transition; copy no longer dedupes
tests.notes: two copy calls → two distinct draft references; source left Submitted before later delete

scenarios.name: A copy carries over the source's answers

tests.test: copy preserves the source answers in the new draft
tests.notes: origin task completed; country select still FR

tests.test: copy leaves both source and copied notifications on the dashboard

requirements.name: A draft notification's answers are recorded as they are saved, and survive being reopened

renders the recorded answers in the numbered design sections

tests.test: creates, submits, amends, cancels, copies and soft-deletes a notification; fulfilment view reflects each transition; copy no longer dedupes

requirements.name: A submitted notification keeps every answer entered, and reopens showing them unchanged

tests.test: lands on the view page with the Submitted strip and reference
still renders the recorded answers after submission
submits a promoted live-animals notification through the hub-owned spine

offers Copy as new and Delete on the read-only view

requirements.name: Amending a submitted notification re-enters it at Overview

scenarios.name: Starting an amendment opens Overview with editing enabled

resubmits an amended notification: Submitted → Amending → Submitted with the edited answer kept
